title: MATES: a deep learning-based model for locus-specific quantification of transposable elements in single-cell RNA-seq
github: MATES pipeline (exact repo URL not confirmed verbatim from source worklog — TODO: fill in before using this record outside this benchmark)
data_accessions: GSE212945 (primary quantification-accuracy benchmark: A375/MEL2 melanoma, matched short-read 10x scRNA-seq + long-read Nanopore, Shiau et al. 2023)
GSE158450 (mouse brain PacBio, secondary quantification benchmark)

annotation_provenance.source: Lab worklog (Google Doc "Work Log"), mirrored partially in /Users/prakx/project_dir/RA/3d-genome-worklog
annotation_provenance.duration: 2026-01-08 to 2026-06-05 (~5 months, ending when the team pivoted to a new project)

data.required: Matched short-read (10x scRNA-seq) and long-read (Nanopore scNanoRNAseq) data from the same biological sample, GSE212945
data.notes: Public via ENA/SRA, but the paper does not say which specific sample (MEL1 vs. MEL2) or cell count was used for the headline benchmark.

code.required: MATES AE+MLP pipeline; scNanoGPS (for building the long-read ground truth)
code.notes: Both public and installable; scNanoGPS v2.0 (gaolabtools/scNanoGPS).

environment.required: Conda environments for MATES and scNanoGPS
environment.notes: Reasonably reproducible; friction was cluster/queue-related (GPU availability, memory limits) rather than the environment spec itself.

model_checkpoints.required: None — MATES trains its own AE+MLP per dataset

parameters.required: Exact STARsolo alignment command/flags; RepeatMasker annotation version; GENCODE annotation version; exact sample/cell-count selection for the nanopore validation set
parameters.notes: Confirmed absent by a dedicated audit of the paper's own peer-review correspondence, not just the manuscript: exact STARsolo multi-mapper/barcode flags were missing from the original submission; RepeatMasker and GENCODE versions were never specified; and the paper never states which GEO sample, how many cells, or whether samples were pooled for the nanopore validation.

blockers.description: Exact STARsolo alignment parameters (multi-mapper retention flags, barcode matching strategy) used to produce the paper's 1185-cell whitelist are undocumented; confirmed missing even from the original submission per peer-review record.
RepeatMasker track version and GENCODE annotation version used for both the MATES reference build and the ground-truth featureCounts step are never specified.

The paper says "melanoma brain metastasis dataset" without naming which GEO sample (MEL1 vs. MEL2), how many cells were used, or whether multiple samples were pooled for the R²=0.7531 nanopore-validation figure.

methodological_risks.description: Using long-read-derived values as both a training prior (for a VAE/Bayesian extension) and the evaluation ground truth risks circular validation — independently flagged twice by the PI across separate extension attempts, and not a resource-availability issue per se but a trap anyone reusing MATES's long-read-prior design should watch for.

per_result_analysis.notes: Best reproduction reached R²=0.7396 — within ~0.3% of the paper's reported value.

per_result_analysis.result: Fig. 7a-equivalent: MATES vs. long-read ground truth, subfamily-level per-cell R² (paper reports 0.7531)
per_result_analysis.notes: Converged toward but never matched the target across ~4 months. Cell-count mismatches (1189 vs. 1016 vs. 875 shared cells) traced to an undocumented scNanoGPS barcode-merging step; final plateau at 0.7125 (1016 cells) / 0.7119 (1189 cells).
Ranged 0.7109-0.8654 across configurations; never simultaneously matched alongside the per-cell number above.

scoring_rubric_v0.1.notes: Scored out of the blueprint's 100-point rubric. Slightly higher than LocusMasterTE on environment/execution (better-documented pipeline), but the same core weakness: parameters_configuration and result_traceability are both low because the exact benchmark configuration cannot be recovered from public materials.

verified_reproduction.summary: The simulation-based benchmark (Polyester/Alu, R²≈0.74) was reproduced almost exactly. The primary real-data benchmark (per-cell R²=0.7531, pseudo-bulk R²=0.9276) was approached (best: 0.71-0.75 per-cell, 0.71-0.86 pseudo-bulk) across roughly four months of iteration but never matched. A dedicated audit of the paper's peer-review correspondence confirmed the residual gap cannot be closed from public materials alone: STARsolo parameters, annotation versions, and the exact validation-sample composition are all undisclosed. Unlike LocusMasterTE, this is not one single missing artifact but several compounding undocumented parameters, closer to a 'moderate reproducibility, exact match structurally impossible' case than a hard block.
